correctness.rationale: The ambient Galois-line types and osculating-plane equation are read directly from Higashine. Points at W=0 force all L_t; the additive kernel of t²+dt forces all M_d for d≠0. Intersections L_t∩L_u=[tu:t+u:1] and their unique M_{t+u} give an exhaustive incidence census. Induction via arbitrary-characteristic addition–deletion computes free exponents; elementary rational inclusion–exclusion proves all extension counts. An exact standalone checker passes on three finite fields; no infinite conclusion is inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: The unique optimal cover measures the covering efficiency of geometrically distinguished Galois lines on their osculating plane. A complete no-node incidence lattice, a modular point, free exponents, and all-extension complement arithmetic are natural structural invariants, not a parameter substitution or isolated small computation.
